title: SSRF found in Acme — The API endpoint `/api/preview?url=` fetched user-supplied U
raw_markdown:
# SSRF found in Acme — The API endpoint `/api/preview?url=` fetched user-supplied U

**Program:** Acme  
**Severity:** high  
**Bounty:** $750  

The API endpoint `/api/preview?url=` fetched user-supplied URLs server-side without validation. Sending `http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` revealed AWS instance credentials.

**Payload used:**
```
http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/iam/security-credentials/
```

**Fix:** blocklist internal IP ranges and require a URL scheme allowlist.

Impact: exfiltration of AWS metadata.

**Tools mentioned:** burp, curl
